subject: Private Offer: multi-division buyer approvals & term proposal
messages:
From: Tim Bradley <tim.bradley@acmehealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Lisa Cheung <lisa.cheung@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer questions: approvals across divisions and term flexibility

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team was impressed with Redwood's latency and observability. We're exploring an AWS Marketplace private offer for a pilot across two business units (Clinical Ops and Analytics). Before we proceed, procurement wants clarity on three items so we can schedule an internal approval window: 

1) If we do a single private offer covering both divisions, what approvals are required on our side (procurement only, or separate finance/legal signoffs per BU)?
2) What flexibility do you offer on term lengths (12 / 24 / 36 months) and mid-term add-ons?
3) For co-sell/marketplace incentives, does Redwood provide any documentation to confirm the offer is eligible for AWS co-sell uplift (we need this for forecasting)?

Can you share a short, actionable checklist we can attach to our procurement packet? We're aiming for an internal decision by 9/10.

Thanks,
Tim
--
Tim Bradley
Director, Platform Procurement
Acme Health
procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Tim Bradley <tim.bradley@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Lisa Cheung <lisa.cheung@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer questions: approvals across divisions and term flexibility

Hi Tim — appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up front, and I'm looping in our AWS marketplace and legal leads for details: Vanessa Ortiz (Marketplace Partnerships) and Marissa Cole (Legal/procurement).

Short answers:
- Single private offer can cover multiple business units; procurement signature is typical, but some buyers route to each BU finance for chargeback confirmation. We recommend including language that designates a primary contracting BU to avoid duplicate signoffs.
- We support 12/24/36 month terms and mid-term top-ups. Longer terms can unlock discounts; we document discount tiers in the offer metadata.
- We will provide an eligibility note and co-sell intake doc you can attach for forecasting.

I'll send a one-page checklist and a recommended approval cadence in a follow-up within the hour. If 9/10 is your decision target, can we schedule a 30-minute sync on Friday 9/3 to walk procurement through the packet?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.com] | +1 415-555-0192

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer questions — recommended gating and docs

Jasmine — quick internal notes to recommend what we send Tim and what to flag for sales/legal: 

1) Buyer approvals: recommend we propose a primary contracting BU with a single procurement signature and a secondary attachment that lists BU budget owners for chargeback. This usually satisfies procurement and reduces legal review loops.

2) Term & pricing: propose a tiered term template: 12m (list price), 24m (5% discount), 36m (10% discount) + an option for annual true-up. Call out that mid-term add-ons are priced at the then-current list less a 3% administrative fee.

3) Co-sell eligibility: we will include an "AWS Co-sell Eligibility Statement" (one paragraph + marketplace offer id) and a completed co-sell intake doc. That should be enough for their forecasting team.

4) Operational ask: attach our AWS_Private_Offer_Checklist.xlsx and SOW_template_v3.pdf. Legal should confirm the primary contracting BU wording and any indemnity thresholds.

Marissa — anything you'd change? Karthik — if this aligns, I can draft the external note and checklist.

-Vanessa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer questions — recommended gating and docs

Agree with Vanessa with one clarification on the BU language: please use the phrase "Primary Contracting Entity" and include an explicit line in the private offer attachments that the Primary Contracting Entity will be responsible for the master payment and VAT/withholding. That prevents downstream procurement from requesting separate master agreements for each BU.

Also: if they request a sub-merchant or delegated billing flow, we need at least 6 weeks to coordinate with AWS marketplace and our finance ops. For term discounts, confirm the list-price basis (we should avoid compounding discounts on top of any promotional credits).

I'll add two short legal bullets to the checklist: Primary Contracting Entity clause and Billing/Tax escalation path.

-Marissa

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Tim Bradley <tim.bradley@acmehealth.com>, Lisa Cheung <lisa.cheung@acmehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Private offer questions: approvals across divisions and term flexibility

Hi Tim / Lisa — following up with the packet we discussed. Attached: AWS_Private_Offer_Checklist.xlsx and SOW_template_v3.pdf (see summary below).

Key proposal (recommended to streamline approvals):
- Single Private Offer covering Clinical Ops + Analytics
- Primary Contracting Entity: Acme Health, Inc. (procurement signature)
- Term options: 12 / 24 / 36 months with discount tiers (12m = list, 24m = 5% off, 36m = 10% off); mid-term add-ons at current list minus 3% admin fee.
- Co-sell: AWS Co-sell Eligibility Statement included (we'll provide marketplace offer ID once created).
- Timeline: 2 weeks to draft private offer + 1 week for Acme internal approvals (if only procurement signs). If multiple BU finance signoffs required, add 3-4 weeks.

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm Primary Contracting Entity name to appear on the offer
- Indicate preferred term (12/24/36) and estimated committed spend for forecasting
- Share any special billing/tax requirements (delegated billing, PO numbers)

If helpful, I'm available for a 30-minute call tomorrow 9/8 09:00-11:00 PT. Otherwise we can meet on 9/10 before your internal decision.

Thanks — Jasmine
